::: {#exr-find-mle}
#### Identifying the MLE

Draw conclusions about the MLE of $\lambda$.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-find-mle}

Since $\ell''(\tilde \lambda; \vx) < 0$,
$\tilde \lambda$ is a local maximizer of the log-likelihood.
Moreover, $\ell''(\lambda; \vx) = -n\bar x/\lambda^2 < 0$ for every $\lambda > 0$,
so the log-likelihood is strictly concave,
and a local maximizer of a strictly concave function
is its unique global maximizer.
So $\tilde \lambda$ maximizes $\ell$, and therefore $\Lik$:

```{r}
#| label: calc-mle
#| code-fold: false
mle <- mean(cyclones$number)
```

$$\hat{\lambda}_{\text{ML}} = \bar x = `r round(mle, 3)`$$

:::
